title: A Life After Layoff - Videos
description:
A Life After Layoff teaches you how to become the CEO of your own career.

I'm Bryan Creely. 20+ years as a corporate recruiter and hiring authority at Amazon, FedEx, and Korn Ferry. I've sat on the other side of thousands of hiring decisions, and most of what actually happens in that room never gets explained to the people it affects.

New videos twice a week: layoffs, hiring trends, interview strategy, and what's really happening behind the scenes at the companies you're applying to, from someone who's actually been in the room.

I built Soor, a resume and job search platform built on everything I teach here. See how it works: https://www.letssoor.com/

Want more? Join my free 1.5 hour webinar for recruiting insights, a real career strategy, my read on the labor market, and subscriber-only offers: https://event.webinarjam.com/register/2/pvmq7hm

My mission: pull back the curtain on hiring and help you land the job you actually want.
